issue.title: Flaky axe outage wedged-lock recovery regression
issue.description: During verification for the core/reference memory vocabulary change, just check escalated to the broad pytest lane and failed exactly tests/test_axe_outage_incident_regressions.py::TestLeakedOrchestratorIncidentRegression::test_ensure_recovers_wedged_lock_and_restarts_axe. The same node passed immediately afterward in isolation on the unchanged tree. The implementation diff does not touch axe lifecycle or outage recovery code, so this should be triaged as an intermittent full-lane failure rather than a regression from this change.

task_type_fields.evidence: Observed once in just check broad pytest lane on 2026-08-24: 1 failed, 22717 passed, 10 skipped. Immediate direct rerun on the same tree passed: .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_axe_outage_incident_regressions.py::TestLeakedOrchestratorIncidentRegression::test_ensure_recovers_wedged_lock_and_restarts_axe -> 1 passed in 7.33s. Serial reproduction not confirmed; fail rate currently 1/2 observations.

payload.description: Broad full-lane/pass-isolation flake cleanup may bear on this node, but the single observation does not prove the same root cause.

payload.entry: SUPPLEMENTARY EVIDENCE: A second just check rerun on 2026-08-24 failed the same node under the broad scoped pytest lane after SASE validation and committed-plan checks passed: tests/test_axe_outage_incident_regressions.py::TestLeakedOrchestratorIncidentRegression::test_ensure_recovers_wedged_lock_and_restarts_axe. Immediate isolated rerun on the unchanged tree passed again: .venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_axe_outage_incident_regressions.py::TestLeakedOrchestratorIncidentRegression::test_ensure_recovers_wedged_lock_and_restarts_axe -> 1 passed in 2.58s. This strengthens the full-lane/pass-isolation classification.
